title: Distributional Reward Calibration and Budget-Neutral Credit Assignment for Multimodal RLVR
abstract: arXiv:2610.40250v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We revisit advantage estimation in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and observe that any token-level advantage admits a two-stage factorization: a \emph{sample-level baselining} step that converts scalar verifier rewards into a comparable sequence-level signal, and a \emph{token-level credit assignment} step that distributes that signal over the trajectory. Existing estimators typically address only one of these stages: affine baselines preserve the shape of each task's reward law, so heavy tails and binary cliffs propagate into the gradient, while token-level credit rules tie the size of each token's update to raw confidence scales and need not conserve the total credit issued by the verifier. We propose \textbf{TACE} (Two-stage Advantage and Credit Estimation), a two-stage estimator that addresses both stages. translated_title: 多模态RLVR中的分布式奖励校准与预算中性信用分配
translated_abstract: 我们重新审视了组相对策略优化（GRPO）中的优势估计，并观察到任何token级的优势都可以分解为两个阶段：一个是“样本级基线化”步骤，它将标量验证器奖励转换为可比较的序列级信号；另一个是“token级信用分配”步骤，它将该信号分布到整个轨迹上。现有的估计器通常只解决其中一个阶段：仿射基线保留了每个任务奖励分布的形状，因此重尾分布和二值悬崖会传播到梯度中；而token级信用规则将每个token更新的大小与原始置信度尺度绑定，且不必守恒验证器发放的总信用。我们提出了TACE（两阶段优势与信用估计），这是一个同时解决两个阶段的两阶段估计器。在第（S1）阶段，我们用一维最优传输映射到标准正态分布来替代线性标准化……
tldr: 提出TACE两阶段优势估计器，通过最优传输奖励校准（样本级基线化）和预算中性的token级信用分配，同时改进GRPO中奖励信号校准与信用分配两个阶段。
en_tdlr: Proposes TACE, a two-stage advantage estimator that jointly improves sample-level baselining via optimal-transport reward calibration and token-level credit assignment via budget-neutral credit conservation in GRPO.
